verdict.rationale: Proton Pass offers bulk import and export of all items (ZIP/PGP-JSON or CSV), and an official CLI with item and vault CRUD built for scripts and CI/CD. That means bulk changes can be scripted, but nothing documents native multi-select or batch operations. missing for 10: native bulk edit/move/delete across selected items, CLI batch commands or bulk-oriented flags, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
